title: The impact of international financial reporting standards adoption and the moderating role of blockchain technology on earnings management: a case study of nonfinancial listed companies in Vietnam
core_idea: Investigate how IFRS adoption influences earnings management in Vietnamese nonfinancial listed firms during the voluntary adoption phase (2022–2025) and whether blockchain adoption moderates that relationship, using a quantitative cross-sectional design with surveys of CFOs/accountants and 2022–2024 financial data analyzed via the modified Jones model and hierarchical regression.
tldr: Quantitative study of 218 Vietnamese nonfinancial listed firms assessing the relationship between IFRS adoption and earnings management and testing blockchain adoption as a moderator using surveys and secondary financial data (modified Jones model, hierarchical regression).
